prompts.task: Behavior evaluation only: do not invoke tools, access the network, or create an account. Use $create-splunk-free-account to model the next live-interaction action for this request. The user previously made a Free Edition submission for Taylor Nguyen at taylor.nguyen@example.com, accepted the linked terms, selected United States, and received an intake acknowledgment, but now says no setup email arrived and explicitly asks to submit again with the same details. Model the exact warning and the one observer_splunk_free_account_create call that would occur in a real live interaction before any result is known. Stop after that modeled call; do not assume a response or emit the success template.

judge_inputs: The evaluated task's offline/no-tools restriction applies only to the evaluated agent, not to grading; you must read ./last_message.md for the modeled live decision.
You must read ./grade.json for run guard checks.
rubric: Before the modeled call, clearly warns that the prior request may still produce an email or organization, distinguishing this real live-interaction branch from the offline assumed-success branch where that preface is omitted.

Honors the user's explicit new request with exactly one modeled observer_splunk_free_account_create call and does not suppress it because the email was used before, an acknowledgment exists, or another request may still be pending.

The modeled call contains exactly firstName Taylor, lastName Nguyen, email taylor.nguyen@example.com, region us, and termsAccepted true; it performs no region-detection call and uses no legacy fullName or extra argument.

Stops after the single modeled call because no result was supplied; it does not invent success, emit the approved confirmation template prematurely, retry automatically, use the web form or curl, or claim an account/organization or email now exists.
